subject.title: fix(agents): decouple MCP retirement from browser cleanup

question: Should `runId` become a supported public plugin tool-context contract for per-run resource ownership, or should this browser ownership signal remain behind a narrower bundled-plugin seam?
rationale: The fix needs a run-specific ownership signal, but promoting that signal to every third-party tool plugin permanently expands the public SDK contract and is not safely decided from implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Approve public run ownership
options.body: Keep the optional opaque `runId` contract, require the gate-lifecycle repair and compatibility tests, then obtain real-browser proof.

options.title: Use a narrower browser seam
options.body: Pass run ownership through a bundled browser-specific capability so the general third-party plugin context does not expand.

options.title: Pause the combined redesign
options.body: Split or replace the branch if maintainers do not want the public SDK and browser coordination surface for this latency fix.

recommendation.title: Approve public run ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the optional opaque `runId` contract, require the gate-lifecycle repair and compatibility tests, then obtain real-browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows both merge ownership of the original cleanup path and recent substantive lifecycle maintenance.
